units: <cite ref="Gittin 58a:4">Gitt. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>תרתי מתלי איסתירא פ׳ וכ׳</he> all the fine gold of the world weighs two Istiras, one half of it is in Rome, and the other in the rest of the world.
<cite ref="Gittin 58a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מחפי בפ׳</he> covered with fine gold.
Ab. Zar. 11ᵇ מתקל ד׳ זוזי דפ׳ (not ר׳, ed. מתקל זוזא דפ׳; Ms. M. פרזא, corr. acc.; Ar. ed. Koh. פִּיזֵּי gold pieces) fine gold of the weight of four Zuz.
<cite ref="Ketubot 77b:9">Keth. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>תכטקי פ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00562"><he>תַּכְתָּקָא</he></cite>; a. e.
